svg.title: Enterprise document automation agent, MCP architecture (illustrative)
svg.desc: A user sends a request with files to an MCP client, an LLM plans tool calls, an MCP server runs 30 plus Python tools for data analysis, file analysis, format conversion and utilities, fetches and stores files in the enterprise document management server, and returns converted files and a summary.
svg.text: MCP architecture: one plain-language request, 30+ Python tools, files straight from the document system
reports to PDF and flag any
2nd place, Huawei GDE AI Competition, among teams from multiple countries and regions
